method: Read all 192 operator-interface and visual-authority propositions, all 53 full context profiles and 16 exact caption occurrence sets, including complete ordered primary experiences, provenance and file-first operator sequences. Full physical-iPhone source context was reread. Every complete original payload and all 1,235 ordered source bindings are verified against immutable evidence and exact source bytes. Archived inputs are verified/read directly from durable hash-pinned regular members without overlay extraction. Fixed UI fields, labels, route ownership and visual authority are distinguished from actual current semantic selection and required triggers. No runtime UI, browser, device, screenshot, test or proof was inspected.

decisions.PRESERVED_FILE_FIRST: Exact authoritative prompt/manifest/input/response/returned-file byte transport remains, with clipboard/paste/text only optional nonauthority. C1 expressly preserves response transport; F2 echoes replace neither actual files nor native input custody. Desktop verification remains required. The physical mobile path has separate changed semantic triggers.
decisions.PRESERVED_SCREEN_REPORTING: Immediate truthful screen position, actual history and canonical-change reporting remain. Receipt and history provenance establish these generic reporting answers, not speculative state or appearance. Actual next action, actor, current prompt, files, blockers, staleness and mode are separately changed.
decisions.PRESERVED_ACTION_SCHEMA: The operationalNextAction-driven screen, every exact action type and structured field, and no prose reverse-engineering remain. F1 adds conditional operations within existing action types and F2 supplies input minima; neither gives the renderer writer/derivation authority. Field presence is distinct from actual current semantic selection.
decisions.PRESERVED_PRIMARY_FLOW: Native run then review with no external prompt/JSON, AI package then fresh independent reviewer then returned files, and human/system instructions then actual observation then returned evidence retain their exact sequences. D/F1/F2 do not change executor identity or replace observation/independence with echoes.
decisions.PRESERVED_ADVANCED: Every specified technical mode/executor/capability/TestIR/schema/hash/context/proposal/ID/routing detail remains under advanced disclosure. New accounting or semantic contents authorize neither unrequested redesign nor exposure of withheld/untrusted data.
decisions.PRESERVED_MODE_LABELS: Exactly one current mode and each original conversation/final-response label remain. Raw capture and file/slot admission stay unchanged under C1. Actual selection from human requests, current prompt, validation/proposal/acceptance/invalidation is separately changed; a stable label does not preserve a changed trigger.
decisions.PRESERVED_CANONICAL_CHANGE: The exact canonical-change, accepted-change, invalidated-stage and new-prompt display fields remain required for every named event and derive from receipts/invalidation records, never CSS. Amended admission changes actual outcomes, not the authoritative reporting fields or their provenance.
decisions.PRESERVED_PROPOSAL_DIFF: Every exact diff column remains, including mandatory current value, temp key, application canonical identity, field/relation, proposed value, raw pointer, evidence and validation. A/B/E resolve through application authority; D changes valid contents without removing columns. C accounting does not require repeated line-by-line human reconstruction.
decisions.PRESERVED_PROVENANCE: The exact navigable canonical-field/extraction-manifest/response-pointer/raw-response/controlling-prompt/evidence path remains, with no graph-library requirement. C exact occurrences and A/E source provenance retain lineage; raw capture is not canonical acceptance.
decisions.PRESERVED_REGRESSION_FIELDS: The pre-correction evidence identity field and ACTIVE/RETIRED permanent-status enum remain, with owning writer/retirement authority unchanged by F1. Actual definition/reproduction/correction/latest-current-run values are separately changed. A displayed identifier is no observation proof.
decisions.PRESERVED_LAYOUT: Current state and next action remain adjacent; lists/prompts/evidence cannot separate them. Required request controls or due-state explanations do not authorize unrelated layout redesign.
decisions.PRESERVED_ASSURANCE: Operator label, SELF_ASSERTED identity and no implied authentication remain. Every purpose declares its minimum and records actual assurance; current purposes explicitly allow SELF_ASSERTED until authentication exists, while any higher required minimum blocks. A answer typing and F1/F2 input basis grant no greater identity or human authority.
decisions.PRESERVED_CANONICAL_ROUTES: Browser prompt, direct UI canonical writes and generic canonical editing remain prohibited. Only the exact input-version/decision/reingestion/recalculation/superseding routes apply. A preserves human-input lifecycle; B/D/E compatibility and F1 current execution do not transfer owning writers.
decisions.PRESERVED_VISUAL: The exact approved visual baseline, restoration, minimal normative additions, advanced disclosure, viewport verification, frozen baseline identity and human authorization rules remain. A/F1 required behaviors do not authorize unrelated redesign or fabricated historical approval. The explicit ambiguous-baseline block is preserved; no screenshots/history/proof were read.
decisions.PRESERVED_OPERATOR_SEQUENCE: The complete ordered external file-first sequence, named slot selection, human review when required, accept/reject endpoint and nonauthoritative previews remain. A uses existing conversation lifecycle and C1 keeps transport. F1/F2 grant no automatic handoff, clipboard requirement or human-review bypass; actual current payload/mode semantics are separately changed.
decisions.EXACT_OPERATOR_CAPTION_GOVERNOR: Each caption retains its own exact original governed occurrences and child IDs, including complete action/provenance/operator sequences. Adjacent standalone clauses and original reviewer extensions remain separate supporting contracts. No inserted amendment is absorbed into a predecessor occurrence set; changed child semantics are separately reconciled.
decisions.CURRENT_PHYSICAL_MOBILE_OPERATOR_PATH: The same pinned actual-iPhone Safari target and physical evidence tuple must exercise the amended path: A answer validity/triggers, C/C1 intake outcomes, B/D/E current proof/native/variance conditions and F1/F2 due/execution/input states. Target equality cannot establish semantic path equivalence. Preserve real device, challenge, exact deployed identity, capability and failure/retry requirements; no proof is accepted here.
decisions.CURRENT_NEXT_ACTION_AND_PROMPT: Actual next action, current prompt, blockers/staleness and mode derived from current prompt/validation/proposal/acceptance/invalidation consume applicable A–F2 current semantic input, accounting, availability, native, variance and execution dependencies. Fixed UI schema/ownership remain; absent/UNKNOWN evidence cannot display readiness and an old receipt cannot establish current acceptance.
decisions.CURRENT_ACTION_ACTOR: The actor for the selected current action includes the F1 conditional pairs only under accepted compatible binding/history, reached phase and TRUE availability. Executor remains the registered reviewed route; no new actor, fallback or authority is inferred. Missing facts cannot be replaced with a guessed actor.
decisions.CURRENT_FILES_AND_WITHHELD_CONTEXT: Actual files to send/withhold reflect C/C1 exact retained supplied/child occurrences, A human context, B/E current test/proof context and F1/F2 compatible fixture/history/target/input binding. Minimum necessary disclosure, blind independence and no future-material exposure remain. Echoes do not prove possession.
decisions.CURRENT_RETURN_REQUIREMENTS: Actual current return/evidence contents include applicable A requests, B proof references, D exact result meanings, E variance and F1/F2 execution/input evidence. Existing response.json/slot transport, actual observation and stronger evidence/independence remain. Input support cannot display execution, semantic acceptance or transfer.
decisions.CURRENT_HUMAN_CONVERSATION_MODE: The actual conversation-versus-final-response selection consumes A closed nonnullable request items, typed answers, blocking default and owning current-input lifecycle. A missing blocking answer rejects and optional unanswered requests establish no fact. Existing mode labels and exclusive lifecycle remain; normal Stage01 conversation is not replaced by the final-response fallback.
decisions.CURRENT_REGRESSION_STATUS_AND_RUN: Actual definition completeness, failure reproduction, correction verification and latest applicable run consume B reviewed availability, D current test semantics, E applicable accepted variance and F1 distinct compatible pre/post observations/history with F2 input basis. Receipt-only routes preserve writers. Missing binding/observations cannot show complete or verified; identity-field and permanent enum structure remain separate.
decisions.CURRENT_STABILITY_DISPLAY_VALUES: Actual ten-run completion/agreement/disagreement/violation/undetermined/new-defect values use current admitted A inputs, B availability, D result/error semantics, E accepted variance and F1/F2 due execution/evidence. Every original run, denominator and metric formula remains. Missing proof cannot count as agreement and future targets cannot be executed early.

qualifier: The separately accepted technical-reference interpretation resolves policy meaning in its exact attributed scope. These historical reference qualifiers are preserved pending explicit per-entry effective-dependency and typed-governor linkage review; they are not a claim that the normative input remains missing or an automatic scope-wide identity change.
